steps.action_code:
def select_app_password(app_name):
    exact_matches = [record for record in account_password_records if record["account_name"].strip().casefold() == app_name.casefold()]
    assert len(exact_matches) == 1
    return exact_matches[0]["password"]

phone_password = select_app_password("phone")
venmo_password = select_app_password("venmo")

def days_in_month(year, month):
    if month == 2:
        return 29 if (year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)) else 28
    return 30 if month in (4, 6, 9, 11) else 31

current_date_parts = phone_clock["date"].strip().split("-")
assert len(current_date_parts) == 3 and len(current_date_parts[0]) == 4
current_year, current_month, current_day = [int(part) for part in current_date_parts]
assert 1 <= current_month <= 12 and 1 <= current_day <= days_in_month(current_year, current_month)
if current_day > 1:
    previous_year, previous_month, previous_day = current_year, current_month, current_day - 1
elif current_month > 1:
    previous_year, previous_month = current_year, current_month - 1
    previous_day = days_in_month(previous_year, previous_month)
else:
    previous_year, previous_month, previous_day = current_year - 1, 12, 31
yesterday_date = f"{previous_year:04d}-{previous_month:02d}-{previous_day:02d}"
print({"target_date": yesterday_date})
verification_targets: Exactly one phone password record is selected
Exactly one Venmo password record is selected
Yesterday is derived as a valid calendar date

steps.reasoning: All sibling contacts must be collected so that feed participants can be matched against the complete sibling set rather than a single page.
steps.action_code:
sibling_contacts = []
contact_page_index = 0
while True:
    contact_page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, relationship="sibling", page_index=contact_page_index, page_limit=20)
    sibling_contacts.extend(contact_page)

        break
    contact_page_index += 1
print({"sibling_contacts": [{"contact_id": contact["contact_id"], "first_name": contact["first_name"], "last_name": contact["last_name"], "email": contact["email"], "relationships": contact["relationships"]} for contact in sibling_contacts]})
